cause_quote: The original usage dashboard built suggestion candidates as `const agents = unique(sessions.map((s) => s.agentId)).slice(0, 6);` (and the same for channels, providers, models, tools) before matching the typed value, so only the first six catalog entries could ever be suggested.
user_saw: Usage filter autocomplete offered no suggestion for a model, provider, agent, channel or tool that was not among the first six catalog entries.
summary: Matched the typed value against the full categorical catalog and applied the six-result cap after filtering.
reasoning: GraphQL blame of the fix parent puts the `options[key].slice(0, 6)` line on deslop refactor 8bfe139a13b, whose diff shows it replaced an equivalent `for (const val of values.slice(0, 6))` slice-then-filter loop; that came from split refactor 68dbbc7c5ff, which moved code from ui/src/ui/views/usage.ts where the cap-before-match lines blame to 8a352c8f9df, the commit that introduced the usage dashboard. The cap-before-match ordering was present from the start, so the bug shipped with the feature.
